title: Membership Opportunities
bodyHtml:
• 2022 
      The Guild of Harwich Artists invites you to submit inquiries about membership via email to info@guildofharwichartists.org. If you would like to inquire in person, please visit the Art Gallery on Main Street at 551 Rte 28 in Harwich Port. If you are ready to join please follow the Membership Application Link at the bottom of the Homepage, submit to the Art Gallery in person or mail to the  Guild of Harwich Artists, Inc. PO BOX 382 Harwich Port, MA 02646 address above. Thank you for your interest.
